input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text or /moves/rook_h8.text must be signed by at least fifteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys, including the moving piece's own key, because both have gone off plan through greed and need stricter agreement than the twelve-signature team rule.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_f8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_h8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false)
